title: Suzhou Once Had 200+ Private Gardens — 9 Are Now World Heritage | China Travel Expert
description:
During the Ming and Qing dynasties, more than 200 private gardens were built in Suzhou. Today nine of them form the UNESCO World Heritage "Classical Gardens of Suzhou," and the oldest date back to the 11th century — nearly a thousand years.

The whole art form is miniaturization: rocks stand in for mountains, ponds for seas, and walls and windows are placed so you never see the entire garden at once. It's a landscape you walk through, not one you take in at a glance.

🧭 Expert Tip: Visit the Humble Administrator's Garden (the largest) right at opening, before the tour groups arrive — early light on the water is the whole point.
